## 1

```{python}
import polars as pl
import sqlite3


basics = pl.read_csv(
  "./title.basics0.tsv.gz",
  separator = "\t",
  null_values = "\\N",
  infer_schema_length = 10000
)

ratings = pl.read_csv(
  "./title.ratings.tsv.gz",
  separator = "\t",
  null_values = "\\N",
  infer_schema_length = 10000
)

principals = pl.read_csv(
  "./title.principals0.tsv.gz",
  separator = "\t",
  null_values = "\\N",
  infer_schema_length = 10000
)

```


```{python}
import adbc_driver_manager.dbapi


conn = sqlite3.connect("./movies.sqlite3")

basics.write_database(
  table_name = "basics",
  connection = "sqlite:///movies.sqlite3",
  engine = "adbc",
  if_table_exists = "replace"
)

ratings.write_database(
  table_name = "ratings",
  connection = "sqlite:///movies.sqlite3",
  engine = "adbc",
  if_table_exists = "replace"
)

principals.write_database(
  table_name = "principals",
  connection = "sqlite:///movies.sqlite3",
  engine = "adbc",
  if_table_exists = "replace"
)
```


## 2
(Utilizando SQL, responda): Quais são os 5 filmes com as maiores notas (averageRating)? Apresente uma solução capaz de desempatar os filmes baseando-se no número de votos recebidos.

```{python}
pl.read_database(r'''
  SELECT b.primaryTitle AS TITULO, r.averageRating AS NOTA, r.numVotes AS VOTANTES FROM basics AS b
  JOIN ratings AS r ON b.tconst = r.tconst
  WHERE b.titleType = 'movie'
  ORDER BY r.averageRating DESC, r.numVotes DESC
  LIMIT 5;
  ''', conn)
```

## 3
(Utilizando SQL, responda): Qual é o gênero mais frequente entre os filmes com nota maior que 8?

```{python}
pl.read_database(r'''
  SELECT g.value AS GENERO, COUNT(*) AS FREQ
  FROM basics AS b
  JOIN ratings AS r ON b.tconst = r.tconst
  JOIN json_each('["' || REPLACE(b.genres, ',', '","') || '"]') AS g
  WHERE r.averageRating > 8 AND b.titleType = 'movie'
  GROUP BY GENERO
  ORDER BY FREQ DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  ''',conn)

```

## 4
(Utilizando SQL, responda): Quais são os 3 atores/atrizes que mais participaram de filmes com nota maior que 7.5?

```{python}
pl.read_database(r'''
  SELECT p.nconst AS ID, COUNT(*) AS FREQ FROM principals AS p
  JOIN ratings AS r ON p.tconst = r.tconst
  JOIN basics AS b ON p.tconst = b.tconst
  WHERE r.averageRating > 7.5 AND p.category = 'actor' AND b.titleType = 'movie'
  GROUP BY ID
  ORDER BY FREQ DESC
  LIMIT 3;
  ''', conn)

```
